name: aether-node-backend
description: nodejs-mobile backend for Aether (Android). main.js is the bundled output of `npm run build:node`. better-sqlite3 is replaced by sql.js, which is kept external (its emscripten glue can't be inlined) and shipped as sibling files sql-wasm.js + sql-wasm.wasm next to main.js. No runtime node_modules. See MOBILE.md.
